The task asked for the age range of the participants, and this evidence supports 20–30; Table 1's 22–26 observed min/max was an alternative figure but was not clearly required over the paper's explicit participant-selection range.

Event_004 shows browser_open with empty arguments opened the Brave homepage, but this was an intermediate step before browser_visit_page successfully opened the PMC article in event_005. The task did not require direct navigation to the URL from the search result, and the browser_open observation matches the action taken, so this is not an unexcused deviation.
